title: Known-object test, TOI-4080.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-4080.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, partial, recovered (42 covered epochs). Residual screen: 25 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 6 light curve(s), forming 8 distinct event(s), 3 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2459912.1818 (ΔT 165.97 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
